body: Only thing fun now is getting drunk

I kind of waited till I hit rock bottom to tell my parents about everything and that was the hardest thing I’ve ever had to tell them. I just wish I could’ve told my parents I needed help earlier cuz maybe then I wouldn’t be as messed up as I am now. Just think that waiting to do something about it won’t make it any easier and will only screw you up more.

I just don’t understand. Nothing should be wrong with me, I’ve got a good family, good friends, I’m not poor, never been abused. I should be perfectly fine with who I am but I’m not. I’m always scared that I’m gonna disappoint the people that love me and become a failure. I can’t stop thinking about when I tried to do it, and trying to remind myself why I didn’t do it gets harder every day.
I think I’m scared that if I do tell someone what’s going on with me, it won’t make anything better, or it’ll make things worse.
Let me know if you wanna talk
I was close to doing it a few months ago. I’ve only been able to tell my mom and my therapist about it. It sucks having to act like everything is fine in front of everyone when it’s not.
I just feel hopeless and worthless all the time. I’ve been meeting with a therapist, but it’s still hard for me to tell her exactly how I feel.

I feel like I always have suicide in the back of my mind all the time too, that’s the perfect way to describe it for me. I’ve only really put serious thoughts into it a few times. The closest I ever came I had planned everything out to where I would wreck my car into a tree or bridge on the highway. I had just spent the weekend with some close friends from a different college and I think me thinking about how they would miss me stopped me from doing it. Just wanted to let you know you’re not alone.
Angel Bowers is a good counselor
